description.value: Cayenne Bistro & Grill is a Burnaby restaurant specializing in East African and Indian fusion cuisine, founded by owner Zeimina who drew inspiration from her mother's cooking. The menu is fully halal and features farm-fed beef and free-range chicken alongside a broad selection of vegetarian and vegan dishes spanning samosas, mogo, biryanis, and grilled tandoori skewers. Delivery and a daily takeaway menu make it a practical stop for cyclists who prefer to eat on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live with recent content (March 2025 blog posts) and confirms the phone number, street address, and business identity. OSM tags community as 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly states 'Burnaby, BC V3N 3M7' — the postal code V3N and the coordinates (49.22, -122.93) both place this in Burnaby, not North Vancouver. Takeout is confirmed by the 'Daily Take Away Menu' page and delivery notice; vegetarian, vegan, and GF options are confirmed by explicit menu notation '(V) Vegetarian (GF) Gluten free (VE) Vegan'; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
